self_improve_harness.description: Before SFT, amplify each round's accepted set with best-of-32 search on the UNDISCOVERED tasks (p~0 at k=1), and select for decomposition diversity rather than pass@1. Targets the discovery->assimilation bottleneck the paper identifies.

budget.total_budget: 6 rounds x 32 candidates/task x 40 tasks = 7680 generations + 6x12 SFT steps
budget.selection_rule: verifier-passing, then max decomposition-diversity within accepted set
